Vitamin B12 is essential for healthy red blood cells, the nervous system and normal brain function. A deficiency can develop gradually, and the early signs may be easy to overlook. Persistent tiredness, tingling in the hands and feet, memory changes, poor concentration, balance problems and a sore or smooth tongue can all be warning signs.
